scope: Finite population and estimator controls; no image classification or new image pixels
assumptions: Joint cumulants use all three centered pairings, including noncircular complex pairings
Gain/noise invariance is population-only, for nonzero scalar gains and additive jointly Gaussian noise independent of the signal
A finite three-point surrogate matches Gaussian moments only through order four; it is not a Gaussian distribution
Unbiased fourth k-statistic assumes iid sample vectors; spatial image windows are not assumed iid

finite_estimator.negative_control: Repeat one random symbol four times; unbiased formula no longer estimates the iid population cumulant

centering_counterexample.claim_to_check: After per-vector DC removal, the entire finite sign-output distribution is invariant under one-pixel circular shift

higher_order_survival.boundary: Ideal finite circular filter, not general JPEG or optical screen capture

phase_grouping.boundary: Distinguish per-record magnitude from complex pooling across unaligned records or independent local shifts

routes: Exact Fraction expectation of expanded k4 polynomial and its square, with analytic Gaussian moments through order8
Five-point Gaussian quadrature and direct sample-centered k-statistic formula
noise_estimator_variance.question: Does population cumulant invariance coexist with increased finite iid estimator variance?
noise_estimator_variance.larger_sampling: Not authorized by this control; do not infer real-window sample size from this toy

variance_mixture_followup.chronology: Motivated after native and window-phase results; registered before this separate finite-mixture suite, not prior control for exposed images
variance_mixture_followup.identity: For zero conditional means: kappa4(X1,X2,X3,X4)=E_G[kappa4(X|G)]+sum_three_pairings cov_G(Cij(G),Ckl(G)), Cij=E[Xi*Xj|G], no automatic conjugation
variance_mixture_followup.prior_theory: Brillinger1969 conditioning identity; this zero-mean specialization follows directly from centered fourth moment minus three pairings, not a new theorem

gaussian_moment_surrogate.boundary: Finite three-point law matches Gaussian through fourth moments, not a true Gaussian sample experiment

corruptions: interpret Gaussian-matched variance mixture as within-condition nonGaussian k4
treat retained sign k4 as zero
apply zero-mean formula to a nonzero conditional mean without refusal
turn empty or zero-probability group into a silent pass
variance_mixture_followup.scope: Known finite conditional populations only, no image grouping, observed noise calibration or source scores. Removing conditional variance mixture does not establish AI specificity.

negative_controls: treat zero-cycle energy cumulant as cyclic artifact
treat normalized cumulant as bounded by one
gate.timing: First bounded execution is a pilot; record actual runtime before any larger compute
